test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 05 Sept, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.

His __amazing__ performance made him famous.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Ordinary.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"amazing"** means something that causes great surprise or wonder; something astonishing. (अद्भुत)

 
 
• **Example: **His amazing skills on the guitar left the audience in awe.
 
 
 
• **"Ordinary"** refers to something with no special or distinctive features; normal. (साधारण)
 
 
• **Example: **He led an ordinary life, with nothing particularly remarkable about it.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'amazing'** is **'ordinary'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Colliery** (कोयला खदान): A coal mine and the buildings and equipment associated with it.

 
 
• **Example:** The colliery was shut down due to safety concerns.
 
 
 
• **Adversary** (विरोधी): One's opponent in a contest, conflict, or dispute.
 
 
• **Example: **In the final match, he faced his old adversary.
 
 
 
• **Binary** (द्वैध): Relating to, composed of, or involving two things.
 
 
• **Example:** The binary system is fundamental in computing.
